OC-Free-Model-Video

Use OpenRouter's free router in OpenCode for small coding tasks and experiments.

1. Install OpenCode

On macOS with Homebrew, run:

brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode

If you already have OpenCode, skip this step. Other platforms can use the installation guide.

2. Connect your OpenRouter key

Create an API key at OpenRouter. Then launch OpenCode:

opencode

Inside its terminal interface, type /connect, choose OpenRouter, and paste the key. OpenCode saves provider credentials separately from your config. See the provider instructions.

3. Set the free router as your default

Search and select it in the model picker.

4. Test it

Exit OpenCode and run:

opencode models openrouter
opencode run -m openrouter/openrouter/free "Reply with: setup works"

The model list should include openrouter/openrouter/free. A reply confirms that authentication and routing work. These commands follow the CLI docs.

5. Use it in a project

From your project directory, start:

opencode -m openrouter/openrouter/free

Try a small task: "Read the README and explain how to run this project." Use /models to switch models later.

If it fails

  • A model-not-found error usually means the model ID or config needs checking. Confirm the full ID above and restart OpenCode.
  • For an authentication error, reconnect your OpenRouter key with /connect.
  • Free inference still has request limits. A coding task can use several requests. If you get a 429, wait before retrying and follow any retry delay in the error.

Docs checked September 30, 2026.
